title: fix: show zero-Pollen notice on authorization screen
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows a friendly notice when the loaded Pollen balance is zero or negative.
- Places the notice before the app details on the shared consent screen.
- Uses shared UI links for Quest and Top up, opening both in new tabs so authorization stays open.
- Keeps authorization available for both PKCE and device flows.

Fixes #14228

gist.headline: The hive checks its nectar
gist.blurb: The authorization screen now notices when a wallet is empty and points people toward Quests or a top-up without interrupting the flow. A small signpost, placed before anyone wanders into the woods.
gist.summary: The shared authorization screen now shows a zero-or-negative Pollen balance notice before app details, with Quest and Top up links that open in new tabs while preserving PKCE and device authorization flows.
gist.impact: People authorizing an app with no available Pollen will see clear next steps without losing or closing their in-progress authorization.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a warm little guide at a cozy authorization desk, noticing an empty pollen jar beside a retro terminal. A friendly sign points to a blooming Quest garden and a small top-up watering can, while the terminal's authorization path remains clearly open and inviting.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny guide scarf, standing beside a retro authorization terminal and an empty Pollen jar; she points warmly toward a blooming Quest garden and a small watering-can top-up station, while a glowing open path continues from the terminal. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and flowers, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, pixel-font sign: 'QUESTS →'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
